requirements.read_protocol_and_terminal_artifacts: AGENTS.md, plan.md, schedule.json, goals.md and every branch's terminal artifacts were read before synthesis. Issue #120 has no comments; its body declares the deliverable.
requirements.verify_branch_coverage_provenance_accoun: synthesis-v1/verification.json records ten reconciliation checks, all PASS: central-ledger recomputation over all 116 attempts, ledger-vs-branch cumulative totals, a full recompute of the 1,152 baseline episode reports against the published evaluation, DAgger 405/405 episodes with 81 paired rows, successor 90/90 episodes with zero trusted-state substitutions, curriculum 243/243 + 324/324, transfer 39/39 cells with 36 paired comparisons, both VALID_STOP branches' terminal admissions, sha256 byte-identity of all five docs-vs-runtime evidence pairs, and goal-audit statuses (goal2-goal10, goal13 complete; readiness PASS).
requirements.reproducible_whole_instance_analysis: scripts/synthesize_expanded_study.py regenerates the complete synthesis CPU-only in ~6 seconds with model_calls=0; --check byte-compares analysis.json, verification.json, claims.json, README.md and all ten CSVs against the published copies and exits nonzero on any drift. Baseline paired whole-problem contrasts use the house bootstrap convention (10,000 paired problem resamples, seed 1729, 95% percentile intervals).
requirements.tables_and_figures: synthesis-v1/ publishes ten CSV tables (branch reconciliation, budget, baseline summary/paired/contrasts, DAgger, successor, curriculum, transfer accuracy/paired) and seven figures (baseline success, baseline validity, DAgger comparison, successor verification, curriculum interaction, transfer deltas, budget), each as PNG and PDF.
requirements.claim_to_evidence_inventory: synthesis-v1/claims.json carries eleven claims with status supported/negative/incomplete/boundary covering matched modalities, DAgger, successor prediction, curriculum, robustness/generalization, replication and transfer; README.md section 9 renders them with evidence pointers.
requirements.negative_results_preserved: Explicit negative claims: base 0/288 with first-decision invalid everywhere; SFT BFS/best-first-width 0/24 per modality (all 144 episodes terminate deterministic_invalid_operation); DAgger null (1/72 vs continued-SFT 1/72, random-valid 45/72); successor model arm 1/45 downstream vs trusted 45/45; curriculum interaction null (all four intervals include zero); transfer null (0/36 survive Holm, min adjusted p 0.8156).
requirements.incomplete_branches_preserved: second_backbone (admission L2) and generalization_robustness (admission L4) are published as terminal VALID_STOP evidence with admission arithmetic; #96, #98, #102 and #103 remain open. Neither branch mutated the ledger; the recovery reserve is untouched.
requirements.v5_and_historical_separation: v5 (3-problem panel, 144 bindings, own ledger) and historical #67 (60/60 saturated, unmatched schedule) are reported in their own sections/claims and never pooled with the expanded 24-problem panel.
requirements.distinct_axes: Operation validity, predicted-state correctness, search quality and compute are separate tables/figures/claims; random-valid is labeled oracle-assisted throughout; no equal-information claim across modalities.
requirements.cpu_only_no_gpu_experiments: The synthesis ran with CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='' and made zero model calls; no GPU jobs were launched by this goal.
requirements.close_only_verified: Only #120 is closed by this goal. #96/#98/#102/#103 stay open; #121/#122 are untouched.

independent_verification.outcome: PASS: checks=10 passed=10 failed=0; byte-identical regeneration of analysis.json, verification.json, claims.json, README.md and all ten CSVs

limitations: Synthesis aggregates existing terminal artifacts; it adds no new model outcomes and cannot complete the VALID_STOP branches.
Bootstrap intervals over 24 problems and one training seed are descriptive bounds, not superiority claims.
The --check mode byte-compares JSON/CSV/README/claims but, following the analyze_matched_v5.py precedent, does not byte-compare figure PNG/PDF files.

Known recorded conservatisms are kept visible: the transfer docs' 3.5993 rounds the ledger's 3.59932 GPU-h, and the second-backbone admission double-counts its 0.63 GPU-h probe window in remainder arithmetic.
